name: WhatsApp Digest
tagline: A daily summary of your busiest WhatsApp groups, without opening them
description: Aimed at anyone who belongs to more group threads than they can follow. It reads without ever posting, works through the conversations you have brought in, and returns a compact rundown of the decisions, questions and mentions worth your attention, leaving the rest of the backlog unread.
author: PetrusJvR
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
